name: How much does a semi-truck accident attorney cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a semi-truck accident attorney cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most semi-truck accident attorneys work on a contingency fee basis. This means you typically don't pay any upfront legal fees. Instead, the attorney's fees are a percentage of the compensation they secure for you at the end of the case, either through a settlement or a court award. If they don't win your case, you generally don't owe any attorney fees. This arrangement allows injured individuals to pursue justice without immediate financial burden.
